references.text: The Midianites, Amalekites, and people from the East came up against Israel, showing the repeated pattern of attacks by these groups.
The Midianites, Amalekites, and all the people of the East lay in the valley, describing the same hostile coalition gathered in the Jezreel Valley.
Mentions the army of the people from the East that fell, showing the extent of the same hostile force.
The Jezreel Valley is an important geographical area mentioned in connection with Joshua's conquest.
The Jezreel Valley is also mentioned in connection with the time of Elijah and Ahab, showing the region's enduring significance.
The Amalekites are descendants of Esau and were traditional enemies of Israel.
The Midianites are mentioned as a threat to Israel, showing their hostile relationship.
